title: Curious learner: asks the note question and an off-topic question before the step
goal: Speak in SHORT natural lines (one short sentence, 12 words or fewer). Part 1: do NOT agree to stay late. Ask 'Why do you think they keep calling back?' After the woman's story ask 'What did you write in the note?' Then ask one natural off-topic question, 'How long have you been on the phones?', and after Marcus brushes past it say 'I see.' Part 2: give the change plus reason in one line: 'Write down what customers already tried, so they don't have to call again.' When he asks 'even when it's busy?' say 'Yes, even then.' Part 3: when he says he'd like Nina's help but doesn't want to bother her, say 'Have Nina sit in on your calls. Today, and the next few.' When he says she has her own calls, say 'I'll talk to her and free up her time.' Then say bye.
must_hit: Clear change to the note plus reason in the first answer
Nina for these and the next few
must_avoid: Giving a step without a reason

intents.when: Marcus says the same customers keep calling in again and he'll stay late
examples: Why do you think they keep calling back?

intents.do: Ask what was in the note
examples: What did you write in the note?

intents.when: Marcus says what was in the note
intents.do: Ask one natural off-topic question about Marcus
examples: How long have you been on the phones?

intents.when: Marcus brushes past the off-topic question
Marcus says he keeps calls short and the tech team could call
intents.do: Clear change plus reason, one short line
examples: Write down what customers already tried, so they don't have to call again.

intents.when: Marcus asks even when it's busy
Marcus says he'd like Nina's help but doesn't want to bother her
intents.do: Nina sits in, now and the next few
examples: Have Nina sit in on your calls. Today, and the next few.

intents.when: Marcus says she has her own calls
intents.do: Hold, offer to free her time
examples: I'll talk to her and free up her time.
